original_diagnostic.terminal: Root reported durable success0, output complete, no timeout/cancel. This exporter does not rerun that job.

source_files.dynamic: Only nonzero-size result.functions[index] entries for 0<=index<64: exact prologue-NNN.txt and prologue-NNN.stderr. No caller-supplied path, glob, recursive walk or further file discovery.
source_files.txt_gate: Full stable raw bytes must match the existing result's prologue_sha256 and prologue_bytes; inspected_address_bytes must equal min(symbol size,512).
source_files.stderr_gate: Same strict derived name, stable owner/type/size checks; its hash is newly recorded because the original result has no stderr hash field.
result_gate: valid recorded ELF before/after SHA256 equal, no invented preexisting hash pin
recorded original native/outer paths/hash/byte counts match
symbols.json equals complete function address/size/names/original_mangled_names projection
both nm exit0 and exact stderr names
final result/symbols reread byte-equal and directory identity unchanged

git_transport.git_helper_delta: Replace check_output with explicit Popen/communicate and drain/wait on the same handle before rethrowing. No kill/terminate or subprocess.run.
git_transport.blob_validation: Original SHA1 Git blob bytes independently verified; full raw bytes retained as UTF-8 up to524288B, otherwise original base64 chunk scheme (393216 raw bytes) plus manifest original size/SHA256.
git_transport.branch_gate: Must be absent initially and immediately before push, then exact published commit readback. No force push.
git_transport.replay: Exclusive output directory; reconcile original idempotency key instead of automatic replay.
